title: 2026 Reunion - CEO Conversation: Tom Gayner & Rich Steinmeier, LPL Financial
description:
On this year's CEO Conversation panel at the 2026 Reunion, Tom Gayner was joined by Rich Steinmeier, CEO of LPL Financial. The panel was moderated by the Micky Quinones, Dean and Professor of Management at the Robins School of Business, University of Richmond.

Tom, Rich, and Micky explored how this year's Reunion theme - the Spirit of Teamwork - plays a role in their organizations.

Learn more about the Reunion at mklreunion.com
